card.text: A spiral galaxy 10.3 million parsecs away, tilted 57° to our line of sight.

sources.quote: Messier 66 or M66, also known as NGC 3627, is an intermediate spiral galaxy located around 31 million light years from Earth in the equatorial half of the Leo constellation.

introduction.text: Its picture is the Sloan Digital Sky Survey's, with the Milky Way's foreground stars removed, laid flat on its measured disc.

Wikipedia, "Messier 66"
sources.quote: This galaxy is a member of the Leo Triplet, a small group of galaxies that includes M65 and NGC 3628.
